body.name: \mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}
body.def: \(\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}(b,f)\) is the centered Gaussian process indexed by \(b\in\mathbb R^{\dim(M_T)}\) and \(f\in\mathcal F_{0X,T}\), with \[\operatorname{Cov}\{\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}(b,f),\mathbb Z_T^{\mathrm{full}}(c,g)\}=P_\xi[(b^{\top}I_T(\xi)+f(Y_0,X)-P_{0X}f)(c^{\top}I_T(\xi)+g(Y_0,X)-P_{0X}g)].\] Thus the displayed covariance specifies the moment block, initial empirical-process block, and every cross-block covariance through the same CFSE influence recursion.
